assets.prompt: Use case: background-extraction. This is an exact background removal edit, NOT new illustration generation. The attached image is the sole edit target. Subject: Hazuki, the orange-clothed witch with round glasses and a raised pink wand. Remove ONLY the exterior white/off-white background and the gray oval floor shadow underneath the character. Return a PNG with real transparent alpha (RGBA), no checkerboard painted into the image, no solid background. Preserve every existing character pixel and detail as closely as possible: exact face, eyes, glasses when present, outlines, original colors, white gloves and white clothing areas, hair, hat, wand, body, pose and proportions. White regions inside the character must remain opaque. Do NOT redraw, redesign, smooth, recolor, enhance, re-pose, add or remove character details. Do not remove the wand, its fine handle, fingers, shoes or thin outlines. Composition/framing: The original tall 282 by 587 portrait framing and all character/wand extremities; preserve the original aspect ratio and positioning with no crop, stretch or added decorative margin. No new shadows, no glow, no border, no text. The only requested change is clean extraction of the existing exact character art onto true transparency.
assets.method: Built-in ImageGen alpha guide resized to original dimensions and thresholded at128; original colored/dark linework opacity restored; neutral exterior halos removed only within the outer2-pixel guide band. Entire source RGB retained unchanged.
